title: Inventory with clamping
prompt: There are 5 items with ids 0..4, all starting with stock 0. The input is a list of updates pair(item id, delta), applied in order; ids are always in 0..4. Each update adds delta to that item's stock; if the result would be negative, the stock becomes 0 instead and the update counts as clamped. Return pair(list of the final stocks of items 0, 1, 2, 3, 4 in that order, number of clamped updates).
